beats.say: Polygon says the Ocarina of Time remake takes up 27 GB.
That is larger than Tears of the Kingdom, which takes up 24 GB.
IGN reports that the visuals in this ground up remake have a vast upgrade.
Polygon notes the original Nintendo 64 version was released back in 1998.
The remake will launch exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 on Nov. 5.
Do you have enough space for the new Zelda on Nov. 5?
